title: Concept: Spring Actuator session list
description: A Spring Actuator sessions document in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The list shows every active session with its principal and attributes, which is both a customer-data leak and a map of who is logged in right now.
applicability: Deployments that render a Spring Actuator sessions document into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The list shows every active session with its principal and attributes, which is both a customer-data leak and a map of who is logged in right now.
